Title: Create RFQ for a vendor
Steps:
1. Purchase > New
2. Select vendor, add product line
3. Save
Expected Result: RFQ saved in state RFQ with correct total KES 40000

Title: Send RFQ by email
Steps:
1. Open RFQ
2. Click Send by Email
Expected Result: State changes to RFQ Sent; email logged in chatter

Title: PO above threshold blocked for normal user
Steps:
1. Create RFQ Office Chair x15 (KES 120000)
2. Confirm Order
Expected Result: Error says manager approval is needed; PO stays draft

Title: Manager approves PO above threshold
Steps:
1. Log in as Manager
2. Approve
3. Log in as User and confirm

Title: Receive full quantity
Expected Result: Receipt done; on-hand +5; PO received qty = 5

Title: Partial receipt creates backorder
Steps:
1. Set done qty 6
2. Validate
3. Choose Create Backorder
Expected Result: Receipt done for 6; backorder for 4 created

Title: Bill matches received qty (3-way match)
Preconditions: TC-08 done; billing policy = received qty

Title: Bill above received qty flagged
Steps:
1. Create bill
2. Change qty to 10
3. Post
Expected Result: Warning shown or bill not matched to PO lines; flagged for review

Title: Post vendor bill
Steps:
1. Set bill date and reference
2. Confirm
Expected Result: Journal entry: Dr Expense/Stock Interim, Cr Payables; state Posted

Title: Duplicate vendor reference warning
Steps: 1. Create new bill same vendor and same reference

Title: Cancel PO after receipt not allowed
Expected Result: Odoo blocks cancellation or asks to return goods first
